messages.author: 95dbe0b4bdd93256
messages.subject: Issue with gl.report.heterozygosity and gl.report.diversity
parts:
Hello everyone, 
I am using the latest CRAN version of dartR and I am having an issue with a very large dataset. I have 22-25 indiviuals of 55 accessions (ca 1300 samples total) and around 80K snps. 

I ran the commands gl.report.heterozygosity  and gl.report.diversity with this data.

With both commands I got the same value in every column and matrix
gl.report.heterozygosity
pop nInd nLoc nLoc.inv Ho Ho.adj He He.adj G10298 25 36 0 0.002359 0.002359 0.120968 0.120968 G1173 24 36 0 0.002359 0.002359 0.120968 0.120968

I got a very similar result with gl.report.diversity 

> div_indices$zero_H_alpha 
G10298   G1173  G12027  G12709 G12709A G12709B   G1368  G13955 
1       1       1       1       1       1       1       1


However, when I use a very small subset (ca. 500 markers, all samples) this does not happen.
Have you ever seen something like this? what could be the couse of this behaviour?

Thanks a lot in advance.

Best regards,

Miguel Correa

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Issue with gl.report.heterozygosity and gl.report.diversity
parts:
Hi Miguel,

I have tested the functions with many loci and with a subsample of loci. I could not find any difference.
I could not completely figure out what you did. Next time try to send the exact code you used so we are in a better position to help. I think that what you did is the following:

# your complete dataset
test <- your_dataset
# running diversity functions
res_test_het <- gl.report.heterozygosity(test)
res_test_div <- gl.report.diversity(test)
# comparing results
rbind(res_test_het$He,unname(res_test_div$two_H_alpha ))

#subsampling 500 loci
test_2 <- gl.subsample.loci(your_dataset,n=500)
# running diversity functions
res_test_2_het <- gl.report.heterozygosity(test_2)
res_test_2_div <- gl.report.diversity(test_2)
# comparing results
rbind(res_test_2_het$He,unname(res_test_2_div$two_H_alpha ))

Could you try running the code above and let us know whether you get different results between the functions.

Cheers,
Luis
